text: Canadian road signs tend to be **less wordy** compared to their US counterparts. Good examples of this are railroad crossing and yield signs. In the US, these usually have the literal words ‘railroad crossing’ and ‘yield’ written on them, whereas in Canada, these signs are typically** **blank.
text_zh: 與美國相比，加拿大的道路標誌通常**較少文字**。平交道標誌與讓路標誌就是很好的例子。在美國，這些標誌通常寫著 ‘railroad crossing’ 和 ‘yield’ 字樣，而在加拿大，這些標誌通常是** **空白的。

text: Road signs in the US tend to use **more words** compared to their Canadian counterparts. A good example are railway crossing signs, which feature the literal words ‘railroad crossing’ on them. In Canada, these signs are typically blank.

This tendency is also noticeable on [yellow diamond warning signs](https://goo.gl/maps/ySfoRRrDjUqSRSub6). In Canada, the words will usually be on a rectangular sign below the yellow diamond, which would have a diagram on it instead.
text_zh: 相較於加拿大，美國的道路標誌傾向使用**更多文字**。一個很好的例子是鐵路平交道標誌，上面直接印有「railroad crossing」字樣。而在加拿大，這些標誌通常是空白的。
這種傾向在[黃色菱形警告標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/ySfoRRrDjUqSRSub6)上也特別明顯。在加拿大，文字通常會位於黃色菱形下方的一個長方形標誌上，而菱形本身則會改用圖示。

text: Czech railway crossing signs do **not** have a background.

NOTE: [Slovak](https://www.google.se/maps/@48.5221855,17.4540175,3a,15y,74.7h,97.77t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sD6lspMXwIUgsJJU74xCt6Q!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) railway crossing signs have a white rectangular background.
text_zh: 捷克的鐵路平交道標誌**沒有**背景。
注意：[斯洛伐克](https://www.google.se/maps/@48.5221855,17.4540175,3a,15y,74.7h,97.77t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sD6lspMXwIUgsJJU74xCt6Q!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)的鐵路平交道標誌有白色的長方形背景。

text: The Slovak railway crossing sign has a white **rectangular background**.
NOTE: [Czech](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.9821592,15.293333,3a,15y,252.56h,95.32t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1seauodxqef41k7Ijnp-XHVA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) railway crossing signs do not have a background.
text_zh: 斯洛伐克的鐵路平交道標誌具有白色的**矩形背景**。
注意：[捷克](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.9821592,15.293333,3a,15y,252.56h,95.32t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1seauodxqef41k7Ijnp-XHVA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)的鐵路平交道標誌沒有背景。

text: The backside of railway crossing signs have a yellow sticker with a 5-digit ID number. The **first digit** indicates the region, and it predominantly increases to the northeast.
NOTE: The first digit may also be a [6](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Z5Wq8nqJarmQYXi76), which can be found randomly throughout most of the country.
text_zh: 鐵路平交道標誌的背面有一張帶有 5 位數 ID 編號的黃色貼紙。**第一位數字**表示地區，且主要由西南往東北遞增。
注意：第一個數字也可能是 [6](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Z5Wq8nqJarmQYXi76)，這可以在全國大部分地區隨機找到。
